title: ADSE P13 Baseline Cryptographic Sealing & Immutability Proof

verificationSteps: 1. Create Configuration Baseline with unique evidence references
2. Calculate SHA-256 Merkle root over evidence references (evidenceRootHash)
3. Attempt to mutate the list of configuration items in-place
4. Compare original hash with new calculated hash
immutabilityVerification.exceptionThrown: BASELINE_IMMUTABILITY_VIOLATION: Baseline is cryptographically sealed. Direct modifications are strictly prohibited.
